name: Decimation makes a whole Warbringer cast crit and is consumed once per cast, not per target (#5331)
contract: Decimation 524913 (StackAmount 0, no real stacking) reads 'Your next Skulltaker or Warbringer is guaranteed to critically strike for $s2% increased damage. Lasts $d.' Warbringer 802581 is a self-centered AoE ('Slam the ground ... to nearby enemies'), EffectImplicitTargetA/B 22/16, EffectChainTarget 5, EffectRadiusIndex 14 (SpellRadius row 14 = 8 yd), RecoveryTime 6000ms, CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset. In src/server/coa/AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp, BeginResources (called once per cast from OnSpellBeforeEffects, sScriptMgr::OnSpellBeforeEffects at Spell.cpp:3996) copies the live Decimation aura's sequence number into spell->SetScriptValue(524913, sequence) once, spell-scoped; OnSpellCritChance and OnSpellCalculatedTarget (both per-target, but reading the same spell-scoped value) force chance=100 and result.crit=true for every target the AoE hits. ConsumeSelected is called exactly once per cast, from OnSpellCast (sScriptMgr::OnSpellCast at Spell.cpp:4134, invoked once at the end of Spell::cast(), not per target -- sScriptMgr::OnSpellHitResult at Spell.cpp:3019 is the per-target hook and is unrelated to this call site). ConsumeSelected reads the aura's own internal counter via aura->GetScriptValue(524913) (set to 5 on Apply in AscensionXorothAuras.cpp, a separate script-value key from the 500906 sequence used for instance matching) and decrements it by exactly one per call; since the call happens once per cast regardless of how many of the AoE's targets were hit, a single 2-target Warbringer cast must move the counter from 5 to 4, not 5 to 3. This proves the specific #5331 claim (stack drained once per AoE target instead of once per cast) does not reproduce against the current source.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Decimation's internal counter starts at 5
Fixture: Warbringer is a Demonfire spender (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp: Spender(info) && !Count(500906) => SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER)
SETUP: the AoE hit enemy2 too
CONTRACT: Decimation forces a crit on enemy1
CONTRACT: Decimation forces a crit on enemy2 too, within the same cast
CONTRACT: hitting 2 targets in one cast consumes Decimation's counter once (5 to 4), not twice (5 to 3)
REGRESSION: Decimation is still active after a single non-draining cast
Fixture: Warbringer consumes Demonfire on the first cast, so it needs re-granting
SETUP: the second AoE cast hit both enemies again
REGRESSION: a second 2-target cast decrements the counter by exactly one more (4 to 3)
